explanation: The Almighty Creator who spoke through his prophets and has now completed his speech with his Son, Jesus Christ.
The prophets and leaders God used in the past to communicate his message to people before the coming of Christ.
Jesus Christ, the perfect image of God who is heir over all things and through whom the world was created.
A metaphor for Jesus' divine nature and his eternal glory that radiates from him.
The title or status Jesus received after his resurrection, where he is exalted above all angels.
God's servants, spiritual beings who were used to bring God's word in the past but are under the authority of the Son.
The symbol of Jesus' sovereign power and rule over the universe after he has purified sin.
Actions or conditions that separate people from God, which Jesus removed through his sacrifice to cleanse humanity.
The place where Jesus now sits at God's right hand in his perfect glory and authority.
